name: Monster Loot Refresh
summary: Common monsters in the mines now and then drop a bit of ore, a geode or another handy extra that suits their floor.
logoPrompt: A single open leather loot pouch with a few copper, iron and gold ore nuggets and a cracked geode spilling out of it

cover.tagline: Better loot on every floor of the mines.
bullets: Ore and geodes that fit the floor

description: **Monster Loot Refresh gives eleven common monsters of the Mines one or two small extra drops that fit their floor.**
- Slimes pick up the ore of their floor: copper ore from green slimes, iron ore from blue ones, gold ore from red ones.
- Rock crabs shed stone and copper ore, duggies dig up clay, grubs sometimes leave a cave carrot.
- Stone golems, frost bats and lava crabs can drop their floor's geode; dust sprites and metal heads carry iron or gold ore.
- Every vanilla drop keeps its chance. No bars, gems or rare items.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Fight in the Mines as usual.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher. It only adds to the drop lists, so other packs' edits stay intact.
- The extras belong to the monster type: green slimes on the farm or in the Secret Woods drop them too.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
